titulo: Chilling footage shows Molly Ticehurst’s murderer saying ‘I can’t believe I just did that’, court hears
cuerpo: Victim’s father Tony Ticehurst confronts Daniel Billings during sentence hearing in regional NSW, saying ‘I hope that every night Molly’s screams keep you awake’ Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast A New South Wales court has been shown chilling footage of Daniel Billings driving away from Molly Ticehurst’s house after he had murdered his former partner in a frenzied stabbing attack in 2024. Billings raised a bloodied hand to his face and recorded a video message, which was aired during his supreme court sentence hearing in Orange on Thursday. Continue reading...
